description: We are CYPHER, a passionate team interested in space, science, technology, programming, and AI. We aim to collaborate, learn from each other, and create an innovative solution for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We welcome creative and motivated members interested in programming, research, design, science, problem-solving, and teamwork.
summary: Our project, MARS PATHFINDER, is a web application designed to help researchers and space exploration engineers understand the Martian surface and identify suitable routes for robotic rovers. The application analyzes Martian geographical and terrain data, including elevation, slope, and geological features, to identify potential challenges and risks that rovers may encounter while traveling across the planet. It provides an interactive 3D map of Mars, terrain analysis tools, route comparison, risk assessment, and a simplified rover mission simulation. Our main goal is to transform scientific data into clear and understandable visual information that can support better decision-making when planning future Mars exploration missions.
